description: Per-example joint CTC-attention objective from Kim et al., Sec. 2.3, Eq. (14) (https://arxiv.org/html/1609.06773): combines caller-computed CTC and attention negative log-likelihoods with ctc_weight as lambda, then applies batch reduction (implementation: src/topologies/implementations/losses/ctc_attention.py:43-48).

examples.title: Train with the joint CTC-attention objective

name: Joint CTC-attention loss

parameters.additional parameters: ctc_weight is the only accepted value in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ctc_weight: required finite real weight in [0, 1] mapping to paper lambda; the paper specifies no default
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because both inputs are already-computed sequence-level loss components
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point per-example CTC negative log-likelihood tensor with shape [B]
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example mixtures, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point per-example attention negative log-likelihood tensor with shape [B], matching shape, dtype, and device
